faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) for filling contractual teaching positions in the institution.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by CUSAT?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Assistant Professor (on Contract) under the Department of Chemical Oceanography and related academic streams.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Assistant Professor (on Contract) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for CUSAT Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Masters Degree with 55% marks in Hydrochemistry or Chemistry along with a valid NET qualification. Ph.D is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹45,000/- per month, and those with a Ph.D will receive ₹47,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for CUSAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application as well as receiving the hard copy of the application is 6 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General candidates?
faq.answer: General candidates are required to pay an application fee of ₹950/- as specified in the official notification details.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: SC and ST category candidates enjoy a concessional application fee of ₹195/- for submitting their recruitment forms.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official portal and subsequently send a hard copy of the application with supporting documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates send the hard copy of their application?
faq.answer: The hard copy of the online application along with fee receipts and documents must be sent to The Registrar, Cochin University of Science and Technology, Kochi - 682 022.
